## Fix CI Build Failure - YAML Frontmatter Errors in Chinese Documentation

The build was failing due to YAML syntax errors in two Chinese MDX files caused by improper use of quotation marks in the frontmatter.

### Errors Fixed:
- [x] Fix `content/docs/concepts/security_architecture.cn.mdx` - Bad YAML indentation on line 2-3 (Chinese quotes in description)
- [x] Fix `content/docs/index.cn.mdx` - Unexpected character at line 26 (Chinese quotes in JSX attribute)

### Root Cause:
Chinese quotation marks (`"` and `"`) in YAML frontmatter and JSX attributes were causing parsing errors.

### Solution Applied:
1. **security_architecture.cn.mdx**: Properly escaped the Chinese quotation marks in the YAML frontmatter description by using single quotes around the entire value
2. **index.cn.mdx**: Replaced Chinese quotation marks with angle quotation marks (「」) in the JSX Card component description attribute

### Verification:
✅ Build now passes successfully locally
✅ All MDX files parse correctly
✅ No other Chinese MDX files have similar issues
